claims.summary: Slide deck compilation now runs one final export pass over every slide bullet, preserving sentence punctuation on long authored bullets while leaving short labels and relationship-arrow concept pairs intentionally bare.

The source-finder discipline-anchor gate now applies to background providers such as Wikipedia in genetics/genomics contexts, rejecting generic environment/testing/background rows that lack a genetics anchor in the source text.
Focused regression coverage pins both live failure shapes while preserving source-license review findings as carry-forward debt instead of weakening the grader.
